CHAPTER.VERS: How dearly loved is the place where you live, of hosts!
How I long and yearnfor the courts of the .Now heart and flesh cry for joyto the living God.
Even the sparrow has found her a homeand the swallow a nest,to lay her young,near your altar, of hosts,my king and my God.
Happy those who live in your house,praising you evermore. (Selah)
Happy are those whose strength is in you,people with pilgrim hearts.
As they pass through the valley of tears,they make it a place of fountains,clothed with the blessings of early rain.
From rampart to rampart on they march,till at last God reveals himself in Zion.
, God of hosts, hear my prayer,give ear, O God of Jacob. (Selah)

Behold, O God, our defender,and look upon your anointed,for better a single day in your courtsthan a thousand in my own chambers:better stand at the door of the house of my Godthan live in the tents of ungodliness,for the is sun and shield,the gives grace and glory.He withholds no good thing from the life that is blameless.
of hosts,happy the person whose trust is in you.
